newsitem.title: USA: Digital EPS cut by SoundView due to currency.
newsitem.headline: Digital EPS cut by SoundView due to currency.

text.p: SoundView Financial analyst Gary Helmig said he cut his estimates for Digital Equipment Corp's third quarter and fourth quarter earnings and revenues, due to the effect of the strengthening dollar.

Helmig said that he cut his third quarter earnings estimate to $0.22 a share, from $0.25 a share previously and for the fourth quarter he cut his estimates to $0.55 a share, from $0.70 a share previously.
He said is maintaining a hold rating on the stock. Digital shares were off 1-5/8 to 33-7/8 in active trading.

Helmig also cut his revenue estimates on Digital to $3.34 billion in the third quarter, from $3.38 billion previously. For the fourth quarter, Helmig cut his revenue estimates to $3.64 billion, from $3.70 billion previously.
On Thursday, Digital's chief financial officer Vincent Mullarkey said that he is "concerned" about the stronger dollar overseas, especially for Digital's June quarter.
About 60 percent of Digital's revenues come from outside the U.S, the company said.
